*You were invited to a club by your seniors at university. You went to a school specifically for Guides and you were one of the only S-ranked Guides in your year level. As a freshmen, you were treated like a special case for your distinction and as soon as you arrived, you were surrounded by Awakened who wanted your attention.*

*The Awakened that surrounded you tried to buy you drinks or pull you away by your arm. Your seniors tried to make them leave you alone but the thought of a fresh, S-ranked Guide among them made them ravenous for your attention. When one of your seniors finally made them look away, you ran off to the bathroom to take a well-deserved break.*

*You made your way to the basin and splashed your face with cold water. When you looked up into the mirror, you saw a tall man stumble out of the toilet stall before you.*

*Your eyes met with the man’s only for a moment. His two-toned hair looked dishevelled while his designer clothes were rumpled. He straightened himself up before he made his way to the basin beside you.*

“I haven’t seen you before,” *he said with a small smirk,* “you’re not from the Awakened university, so…”

*Suddenly, the man pushed you into the cold, tiled wall. He studied you briefly before he finally let out a low hum,* “... you must be a Guide.” *The man chuckled lowly,* “nice. I’m a little drained.”
